about.bio:
As an Informatics Engineering student at Universitas Teknologi Bandung, I focus on turning complex ideas and requirements into efficient web applications.

From architecting frontend interfaces to building full-stack solutions from the ground up, I thrive on creating scalable digital products that deliver a real impact for users.

description: Configured automatic pre-commit hooks using Husky and lint-staged to enforce code quality standards (ESLint & Prettier) before every git commit.
Set up a local Docker Compose-based development environment for PostgreSQL database to maintain infrastructure consistency across the team.
Implemented an isolated monorepo architecture to streamline development workflow and separate dependencies between Next.js frontend and NestJS backend.
Optimized local dependency installation and script execution workflows using Bun runtime to minimize build times.
